description: Ground truth valid values, formats, and ranges for pasm_policy columns. Used by score_mappings.py and data-quality validation. Amounts are decimal dollars (type: decimal_dollars), NOT integer cents — contrast with pasl_value_catalog.json's integer_cents columns. score_mappings.py's _check_transformation() has no rule for decimal_dollars (returns not-applicable, correctly skipping the /100 check it would wrongly apply for an integer_cents type).

policy_id.notes: Prefix stripped + cast to integer for canonical policy_id.

policy_number.description: Same raw value as policy_id, kept as a string (no prefix stripped) for canonical policy_number.

expiration_date.description: Policy expiration date. Always 12 months after effective_date.

insured_ein.description: Employer Identification Number (commercial tax ID), XX-XXXXXXX format.
insured_ein.notes: PII fragment. Not a generic customer surrogate key despite the 'identifier' framing of the name.

written_premium.description: Annual written premium, ALREADY in decimal dollars.
written_premium.notes: Contrast with PAS-L's ANNU_PREM_AMT (integer_cents, requires /100). Mapping this to premium_amount with a /100 division would be WRONG here.

total_coverage_limit.description: Total policy coverage limit, decimal dollars, no conversion.

policy_deductible.description: Policy deductible, decimal dollars, no conversion.

policy_status.notes: Needs case-normalization to match PAS-L's resolved Title Case values (Active/Cancelled/...) in slv_policy_unified. No code-lookup seed table involved — pure string transform.

line_of_business.description: Verbose line-of-business code. Source for product_code via seed_pasm_lob_map (COMMERCIAL_GENERAL_LIABILITY -> CGL-STD, WORKERS_COMPENSATION -> WC-STD, COMMERCIAL_PACKAGE_POLICY -> CPP-STD, COMMERCIAL_UMBRELLA -> UMB-STD).
line_of_business.notes: No separate product_code-shaped column exists anywhere in pasm_policy. This is the ONLY path to product_code.

agency_code.description: Agency code, same format convention as PAS-L's AGCY_CD.

underwriting_tier.description: Underwriting tier, derived from risk_score at generation time (same derivation rule as PAS-L).

cancellation_reason.description: Cancellation reason code. NULL on active policies.
cancellation_reason.notes: Same code set as PAS-L's CNCL_RSN_CD.

lapse_reason.description: Lapse reason code. PAS-L has no equivalent column (always absent there).
lapse_reason.notes: PAS-M-only field — never appears in PAS-L's column set at all.

original_policy_id.description: Original policy ID for renewal/rewrite chains. NULL for the large majority of policies (only chained ones populate it).
original_policy_id.notes: PAS-L has no endorsement-chain tracking concept at all — PAS-M-only generalization signal.

prior_carrier_name.description: Full prior carrier name (e.g. 'Allstate Fire and Casualty').
prior_carrier_name.notes: Contrast with PAS-L's PRIOR_CARR_CD (3-char abbreviation) — this is a clean full-name match, deliberately easier.

win_back_eligible.description: Win-back eligible flag as lowercase string literals, NOT a Y/N flag.
win_back_eligible.notes: Same canonical target as PAS-L's WINBK_FLG (Y/N, needs flag_to_boolean macro), but PAS-M's encoding is incompatible with that macro — needs a plain string-equality boolean cast instead.

risk_score.description: Underwriting risk score, same 0-100 scale as PAS-L.

commercial_rating_group.description: Commercial product rating segment label. PAS-M-only, CGL/WC/CPP/UMB-specific.
commercial_rating_group.notes: Name resembles underwriting_tier but is a different concept (product rating segment, not this policy's own risk tier).

claims_made_flag.description: Claims-made-vs-occurrence flag. Populated 'true' only for CGL-STD policies, empty otherwise.
